extraction.Name: Mrs. Pearl Frazier
extraction.Refused/Protested: issued to you without your application or consent
extraction.NOTES: Document is a letter from Superintendent E. W. Sermark dated October 20, 1928, requesting Mrs. Frazier to come to the office to provide a sworn affidavit before a Notary Public connected with the Indian Service, in response to a circular letter from the Indian Office requesting information from each Indian receiving a forced Patent.
